# Polaris Group

> Polaris Group focuses on where value is moving in applied AI, carefully selects start ups for private angel investment and convenes the private and public sectors through the Polaris Council. Founded by Marc Taverner, London, working globally.

Full text of both theses for AI tools: https://polarisglobal.io/llms-full.txt

## Theses

- [Investing in the Harness: my thesis on applied AI, governance and sovereignty](https://polarisglobal.io/theses/investing-in-the-harness/): the investment thesis (October 2026). The model is not the asset; own the harness, not the weights; sell to an obligation, not a preference; neutrality is the product; proof is the product; Europe is the long dated opportunity.
- [Agents of Sovereignty: earning and owning value in an economy reshaped by AI, 2026 to 2031](https://polarisglobal.io/theses/agents-of-sovereignty/): the essay behind the public and private work (updated 23 October 2026). Sovereignty means what you can authorise, refuse, inspect and take with you.

## Polaris Fund

- [Polaris Fund](https://polarisglobal.io/fund/): Polaris carefully selects start ups for private angel investment. Founders can submit their company here.

## Polaris Council

- [Polaris Council](https://polarisglobal.io/council/): convenes the private and public sectors on applied AI. Convened on St George's Day, 23 April 2026, at Speaker's House, Westminster.

## Archive

- [Archive](https://polarisglobal.io/archive/): the original 2025 Agents of Sovereignty thesis and the Agentic Universal Basic Income papers, kept on record with a note on what changed. Not current positioning.
